g.text: AWS DIRECT CONNECT · ONE REGION, TWO AVAILABILITY ZONES
The data center reaches a two-zone VPC over Direct Connect; S3, DynamoDB and the secrets stay outside it
The orders database runs in both zones behind private subnets. Amazon S3, Amazon DynamoDB and AWS Secrets Manager are regional services the VPC reaches over endpoints, never addresses inside it.
Prefixes advertised from the IP plan
Region and zones from the landing-zone design
Illustrative topology · hop facts are placeholders, not looked-up values
